images.deleteDesc:
Delete the image "{{name}}"?

By default the deletion fails while a container still uses it. Tick force delete to drop the reference anyway — this can affect running containers.

run.privilegedHint: Privileged mode gives the container far more host access — enable with care.
run.resourcesHint: CPU shares set relative scheduling priority; the CPU and memory limits are hard caps. Start gentle on a desktop.
run.restartAlwaysHint: Comes back after a Docker or host restart. Good for long-running services.
run.restartNoHint: Never restarts after exit. Good for one-off tasks.
run.restartOnFailureHint: Retries only on a failed exit — useful when you want protection without endless restarts.
run.restartUnlessStoppedHint: Like always, except it stays down after you stop it manually. Good for everyday services.
run.submitFailed: Check the run settings and try again
run.title: Run container
run.ttyHint: Interactive containers usually enable both. A background service needs neither.
run.volumesHint: Only host-path bind mounts for now — good for config, data and log directories.
